purpose: Lossless storage deduplication of inspected secondary evaluation copies; historical records and primary submissions are unchanged.

cleanup_summary.policy: Delete byte-identical secondary copies; do not modify any pre-existing retained file, including cleanup.md.
cleanup_summary.inventory_digest_format: Ordinal-sorted UTF-8 relative/path|decimal_bytes|lowercase_sha256 lines, each followed by LF.

restoration_check.result: Every restored path, byte length, and SHA-256 matched the inspected secondary baseline before deletion; canonical inputs supplied the omitted copies.

safety_checks: Absolute, parent-traversal, backslash, reserved-name and alternate-stream refusal
Resolved containment, reparse ancestry, candidate/canonical hash and exclusive-read checks before native PowerShell deletion
No matching active Python/browser runtime at deletion

restoration_usage.fresh_destination: Add --destination with a short empty directory path; a deep temporary destination exceeded the Windows path-length limit during an initial test. The complete successful check used a shorter task-owned path.
restoration_usage.existing_files: Identical files are skipped; differing files are never overwritten.
restoration_usage.reviewer_access: Restore only the selected workspace for a reviewer. Do not expose other attempts or the campaign-wide administrative map as generation inputs.

cleanup_summary.preservation: Original notebooks, outputs, setup/state, results, assessments, access/failure evidence, time/token/event records, source pins, reporting amendments, and the existing cleanup record are unchanged. No attempt was removed or reclassified; the failed-preparation scope remains separately restorable.
limitations: This restores inspected imported bytes, not missing historical snapshots. The earlier 423 missing submission-inventory paths remain absent.

Among 4559 mapped validation files, 1289 match the historical submission hashes and 3270 differ. Only inventory-key separators were normalized for comparison; original pins and current bytes were not changed, and no cause or repair of those discrepancies is asserted.

Historical machine paths and environment assumptions remain unchanged. No notebook, solver, mathematical verifier, renderer, generation attempt, or evaluation was rerun; this does not certify historical completeness, end-to-end replay, or a new experimental PASS.
Administrative cleanup/restoration costs are not added to original experiment time or token accounting. File byte reduction is not guaranteed disk allocation or Git history reduction.
Historical references to omitted secondary files require restoration. Native filesystem rechecks are not an atomic transaction against concurrent writers.

publication_normalization.note: Entry fingerprints describe the published files. Earlier cleanup summaries are historical records.
